name: OSN LP dividend distribution drain
summary: OSN supplied stale and duplicated LP dividend weights: its liquidity-removal transfer hook copied the recipient’s current pair-token balance into the dividend tracker, but subsequent LP transfers did not reduce the previous holder’s recorded weight. Reusing LP across recipients could therefore multiply reward entitlement. The defect is in the token’s weight updates, not the tracker’s owner-only setBalance authorization or the absence of a holding period.

loss.notes: Unverified $109,000 seed estimate retained only as a discovery value. Tracker payouts include legitimate LP yield and are not themselves stolen value; neither full-campaign wrongful entitlement nor a defensible USD lower bound has been isolated.

ageReset.description: Provisional deployment basis; earliest fault exercise and intervening causal configuration remain unresolved.

limitations: Deployment and sampled runtime hashes are reproduced; intervening causal configuration, including trading activation and address exemptions, has not been fully reviewed.
The retained campaign transaction is not established as the earliest fault exercise, so the stored deployment-based age is not a reviewed measurement.

sources.note: Bounded OSN review: Etherscan verified source at https://bscscan.com/address/0x810f4c6ae97bcc66da5ae6383cc31bd3670f6d13#code shows _transfer copying pair.balanceOf(to) into _userInfo[to].lpAmount and lpDividendTracker.setBalance on removal; pair-token transfers do not invoke this token hook. DividendTracker.setBalance is onlyOwner. Source-1 callTracer reproduces direct OSN CALLs and 202 tracker setBalance calls (selector 0xe30443bc); tracker accounting is downstream of token-supplied weights. Source-5 receipt establishes direct creation at block 37874409, index 147, timestamp 1713163426 by the recorded creator. eth_getCode is empty at 37874408 and hashes to the recorded runtime at 37874409 and 38474365. These endpoint checks do not establish complete state continuity. Earlier LP transfers can leave stale donor weights before another recipient is registered; establishing the earliest loss requires replaying those weights and payouts against legitimate entitlement. Full-campaign excess rewards and causal configuration history remain unresolved; no incident or target promotion.

limitations: The recorded transaction is a confirmed campaign execution, not a proven earliest successful exercise; earlier stale-weight payouts require entitlement replay.
The imported USD estimate is unverified; campaign payouts must be separated from legitimate LP yield before measuring wrongful depletion.
